units.title: Pre-Design Processes
units.topics: Understanding and synthesizing brief, User profile and activity mapping, Site appraisal and context analysis, Study of architectural precedents.

units.title: Anthropometry and function
units.topics: Activity spaces and circulation, Spatial relationships and hierarchy, Functional zoning and clustering of spaces.

units.title: Structural assemblies and materials
units.topics: Integration of structure and materials in design thinking, Structural grid and form derivation.

units.title: Thermal comfort
units.topics: To achieve thermal comfort by applying passive design strategies: Reducing thermal loads, Use of passive cooling strategies.

units.title: Building Services
units.topics: Demonstrate a basic understanding of water supply, drainage, electrification, sanitation, and their integration in house design.

units.title: Material Theory: RCC
units.topics: Constituents of concrete, properties of fresh and hardened concrete, water-cement ratio, grades of concrete, reinforcement steel types and grades, formwork and shuttering.

units.title: Framed Construction in RCC
units.topics: Foundation systems: isolated, combined, raft; Columns: short and slender; Beams: simply supported, cantilever, flanged; Slabs: one-way, two-way, flat slab basics; Reinforcement detailing and drawing conventions.

units.title: Specialized RCC Roofing Systems
units.topics: Flat roofs, pitched RCC roofs, waffle slabs, ribbed slabs, coffered ceilings, expansion and construction joints in RCC.

units.title: Flooring
units.topics: Types of flooring materials: stone, ceramic, vitrified tiles, terrazzo, concrete, timber, laying techniques and jointing details.

units.title: Waterproofing and Damp-proofing
units.topics: DPC materials and application methods, waterproofing of basements, terraces, toilets, sunken slabs, retaining walls.

units.title: Design of Wooden joists
units.topics: Working Stress Method - Calculating section size and check for shear and deflection for 1) simply supported 2) cantilever (assignment to identify primary and secondary beams).

units.title: Introduction to IS456
units.topics: Understanding Standard RCC section, Limit State Method, Classifying under-reinforced, over-reinforced and balanced section based on given section size and reinforcement, load factors and assumptions.

units.title: Slabs
units.topics: Design of simply supported one-way slabs, Design of cantilever slabs. Understanding structural behaviour and logic for provision of reinforcement for RCC two-way slab, overhanging slab, one-way continuous slab, estimation of slab depth.

units.title: Beams
units.topics: Design of simply supported beam supporting one way slab, Design of cantilever beam. Understanding structural behaviour and applications of flanged and doubly reinforced beams, estimating beam depth based on span to depth ratio.

units.title: Compression members
units.topics: Design of short columns across multiple floors (G+4). Understanding structural behaviour of columns subjected to moments, concept of uniaxial and biaxial moment columns, concept of strong column weak beam.

units.title: Water supply
units.topics: Sources of water, quality criteria, treatment plants, distribution networks, storage reservoirs (underground and overhead), pumping systems, water supply piping in low-rise residential buildings.

units.title: Hot Water supply
units.topics: Direct and indirect systems, geysers, boilers, solar water heaters, distribution piping and safety devices.

units.title: Vertical Drainage systems
units.topics: Sanitary fixtures, traps, soil and waste stacks, vent pipes, single stack, one-pipe and two-pipe systems.

units.title: Horizontal Drainage systems
units.topics: Building drains, manholes, inspection chambers, intercepting chambers, gradient and self-cleansing velocity.

units.title: Sewage Treatment and Disposal
units.topics: Septic tanks, soak pits, cesspools, packaged STPs, disposal of effluent and recycled water reuse.

units.title: Early Civilisations
units.topics: Architecture @ 3500 BCE to @ 400 BCE: Early civilisations of the Mesopotamian, Egyptian, Chinese people.

units.title: Indus Valley and Vedic Period
units.topics: Indus Valley civilisation, Architecture of the Vedic period.

units.title: Classical Antiquity
units.topics: Architecture @ 400 BCE to @ 100 CE: Classical Greek and Roman architecture.

units.title: Early Buddhist and Jain Architecture in India
units.topics: Rock-cut caves, chaityas, viharas, and stupas.

units.title: Early Hindu Temple Architecture
units.topics: Evolution of temple form, Gupta period temples, Rock-cut temples at Badami and Aihole.

units.title: Introduction to Climatology and Climate Change
units.topics: Climate and weather, elements of climate, climatic zones of India, climate responsive architecture and climate change overview.

units.title: Climatic Data and Tools of Analysis
units.topics: Temperature, solar radiation, humidity, wind, rainfall data collection and interpretation, solar geometry, sun-path diagrams, shading masks.

units.title: Human Comfort in Buildings
units.topics: Thermal comfort indices, bioclimatic chart, psychrometric chart, adaptive comfort models.

units.title: Application of Strategies for Climatic Comfort
units.topics: Orientation, building envelope design, fenestration sizing and placement, shading devices design.

units.title: Passive Design Strategies
units.topics: Passive heating, passive cooling, natural ventilation strategies, day lighting integration.

units.title: Introduction to Site Survey Systems
units.topics: Definitions, objectives, types of surveys, scales, conventional signs and symbols, errors and accuracy.

units.title: Traditional Site Survey Systems
units.topics: Chain surveying, compass surveying, plane table surveying, levelling and contouring methods.

units.title: Modern Digital Survey Systems
units.topics: Theodolite, Total Station, GPS/GNSS, drone surveys, digital terrain modelling basics.

units.title: Systems for Surveying Existing Buildings on Site
units.topics: Measured drawings, documentation techniques, triangulation and offset measurements of existing structures.

units.title: Site Constraints and Opportunities Analysis
units.topics: Topography, slope analysis, hydrology, vegetation, microclimate, access, zoning regulations and site suitability analysis.

units.title: Design of transition spaces
units.topics: Thresholds, verandahs, courtyards, corridors, lobbies, and indoor-outdoor spatial transitions.

units.title: Building Form
units.topics: Form generation, massing, articulation, elevation development, materiality and texture integration.

units.title: Thermal comfort
units.topics: Application of microclimate and passive cooling strategies in institutional/community building design.

units.title: Building Services
units.topics: Integration of water supply, drainage, electrical layout, fire exits, and service shafts in medium-scale design.

units.title: Accessible Design
units.topics: Universal accessibility, barrier-free design principles, ramps, lifts, tactile paving, accessible toilets.

units.title: Introduction to Steel and Joineries
units.topics: Structural steel sections, connections: riveted, bolted, and welded joints, steel stanchions, base plates, trusses, and purlins.

units.title: Ferrocement
units.topics: Raw materials, manufacturing process, properties, applications: water tanks, roofs, doors, precast wall panels.

units.title: Shells and Tensile Structures
units.topics: Single and double curvature shells, hyperbolic paraboloids, domes, vaults, cable and membrane structures.

units.title: Glass and Polymers (plastics) in building industry
units.topics: Types of glass (float, toughened, laminated, insulated), structural glazing, curtain walls, UPVC, FRP, polycarbonates.

units.title: Elevators and Escalators
units.topics: Types, components, lift well, pit, machine room, travel speed, capacity, traffic calculations, escalators and travelators.

units.title: Retaining wall
units.topics: Structural actions on gravity and cantilever retaining wall, proportioning of gravity wall and RCC cantilever retaining wall. Stability check of RCC cantilever Retaining wall only.

units.title: Introduction to steel construction
units.topics: Load transfer from slab panels to steel framing to stanchions -> footing -> ground. Load transfer within steel truss, from truss to stanchion-> footing -> ground. Introduction to welded and bolted connections.

units.title: Steel girders
units.topics: Design calculations only to find the section size based on BM. Steel stanchion - Design calculations only to find the section size. Purlin - calculation of size. Concept of girders and stanchions with added plates, Design of compound stanchion.

units.title: Analysis of Truss
units.topics: Analysis of Truss, Tension member - size calculation, Compression member - Size calculation. Structural actions in Portal frame.

units.title: Different structural systems
units.topics: Roofing - structural actions in truss, arch, dome, vault, folded plate, tensile structures; Structural actions in long span elements - prestressed girder, plate girder, castellated girder, structural actions in tall and heavy columns.

units.title: Water supply & Drainage
units.topics: Water supply and drainage systems for mid-rise buildings, overhead tanks, booster pumps, storm water drainage, rainwater harvesting systems.

units.title: Solid Waste Management
units.topics: Waste segregation at source, organic waste composting, chutes, collection systems, recycling and municipal disposal standards.

units.title: Natural Lighting
units.topics: Daylight factor, sky component, internally reflected component, daylight integration in building design, light shelves, louvers.

units.title: Illumination
units.topics: Artificial lighting: lamps, luminaires, photometry, lux levels, lighting layout design for various interior spaces.

units.title: Electrification
units.topics: Supply intake, transformers, HT/LT panels, distribution boards, conduits, wiring, earthing, lightning protection, backup generators and UPS systems.

units.title: Medieval World Architecture
units.topics: Architecture @ 1100 CE to @ 1500 CE: Architecture in Americas, Japan, China, South East Asia.

units.title: Gothic and Early Renaissance
units.topics: Gothic architecture and early Renaissance architecture in Europe.

units.title: Pre-Mughal Islamic Architecture in India
units.topics: Delhi Sultanate: Slave, Khilji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, and Lodi dynasties, Provincial Islamic styles: Gujarat, Malwa, Deccan.

units.title: Mughal Architecture
units.topics: Evolution of Mughal style: Akbar, Jahangir, Shah Jahan, regional adaptations.

units.title: Temple Architecture of South and Western India
units.topics: Dravidian temple architecture: Chola, Pandya, Vijayanagara, Hoysala, Maratha architecture in Maharashtra.

units.title: Introduction to Environmental Science & Contextuality
units.topics: Multidisciplinary nature of environmental science, ecosystems, ecology, ecological footprint of urbanization.

units.title: Natural Resources & Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) of Building Material
units.topics: Water, energy, land, timber resources, embodied energy of construction materials, life cycle assessment principles.

units.title: Environmental Pollution & Impact of Built Environment
units.topics: Air, water, noise, soil pollution caused by construction activities, urban heat island effect, mitigation measures.

units.title: Introduction to Environmental Legislation
units.topics: Environmental Protection Act, EIA guidelines, CRZ notifications, forest and biodiversity protection norms.

units.title: Introduction to Sustainable Building Practices
units.topics: Green building rating systems: GRIHA, IGBC, LEED; renewable energy systems, net-zero buildings, waste management.
